title: totalfloat error with --json, and MCP tool errors
description: A command that fails prints this on stdout with --json, and MCP tools return it. A batch of edits with several refusals has the code edits-refused and lists each in problems; a batch with one refusal keeps that refusal's code, and lists it in problems too.

edit.description: The edit's place in the batch, counting from 1. Absent for a flag that couldn't be read.

source.description: Where the edit came from: a flag and its text, `edits.json item 3`, `line 4` of a status table, or `edit 2` over MCP.

hint.description: What to do, starting with `did you mean …?` when a close name exists.

depends_on.description: The refused edit this one needed, by its place in the batch.

line.description: The line it came from, for a schedule text file (.tfs).

column.description: The column it came from, for a schedule text file (.tfs).

code.description: Stable and machine-readable, such as file-not-readable.
